title: Pooling Small-N fMRI
blurb: Can many small open fMRI studies be merged into one shared space? A well-controlled negative on a visual tone-poem (alignment hurt, N=93), a synthetic positive control proving the pipeline works, and a narrative-film test that came back underpowered — an honest map of where pooling helps, hurts, and stays undecided
